derivations.epistemic_behavior: Purpose policy classifies each FY2025 measurement-limit pair into enforceable_numeric, report_only, or no_numeric_comparison. Does not persist as world truth. When unit alignment or enforceability cannot be established, emits unresolved rather than silent default.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: One assessment per measurement_limit_evaluation_pair (824 pairs). Universe is fy2025_in_scope_measurement joined to dmr_limit_correspondence; mechanical world compilation is treated as complete for manifest facilities.
derivations.deterministic_computation: SQL join over world relations followed by ordered policy rules: (1) non-numeric DMR value_kind routes to no_numeric_comparison; (2) has_numeric_value=0 routes to no_numeric_comparison; (3) optional_monitoring_flag=Y routes to report_only; (4) limit_type_code=ENF with has_numeric_value=1 and value_kind=numeric routes to enforceable_numeric when standard_unit_code matches dmr_unit_code; (5) unit mismatch routes to unresolved.
derivations.required_premise: Compiled measurement-limit correspondence and source limit/measurement attribute tuples must be present for the pair.
derivations.optional_enrichment: Temporal overlap (limit_effective_during_period) may refine applicability but is not required when correspondence is keyed to active DMR-limit linkage.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Emits within_limit or exceeds_limit only when upstream applicable_limit_assessment establishes enforceable_numeric and measurement value_kind is numeric with aligned units. Otherwise comparison_not_applicable or unresolved; never infers exceedance from missing data.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Candidates are measurement-limit pairs where dmr_reported_value_kind.value_kind=numeric (638 pairs). Pairs lacking numeric measurement or enforceable limit produce comparison_not_applicable rows, not silent omission.
derivations.deterministic_computation: After enforceable_numeric is established and units align, compare dmr_value_nmbr to limit_value_nmbr using limit_value_qualifier_code (<=, <, >=, >). Values on boundary are within_limit.
derivations.required_premise: Resolved applicable_limit_assessment with limit_category=enforceable_numeric and numeric comparable measurement.
derivations.optional_enrichment: limit_source_flags statistical metadata; not used for comparison when units and numeric values are already grounded.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Three-valued logic: required, not_required, or unresolved. Conditional requirements demand grounded trigger or relief evidence before a definitive verdict. not_required requires positive evidence (out-of-season, limit not effective, or established relief), not mere absence of DMR.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Enumerate monitoring_requirement_candidate crossed with same-facility FY2025 monitoring_period where limit_effective_during_period.overlaps=1 (1032 evaluated contexts). Requirement-period pairs with no temporal overlap are excluded from evaluation universe.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Mechanical path: when limit_effective_during_period.overlaps=1 and limit_season_month_active.active_in_month=1 for the period-end calendar month and no conditional_trigger_language exists for the limit_row, verdict=required. When overlaps=0, verdict=not_required with condition_basis=limit_not_effective_during_period. When conditional_trigger_language present, verdict remains unresolved until discharge_occurrence_evidence or conditional_monitoring_relief_evidence is ACCEPT-grounded.
derivations.required_premise: Monitoring requirement candidate and facility-period temporal scope from compiled schedule relations.
derivations.optional_enrichment: discharge_occurrence_evidence, conditional_monitoring_relief_evidence, and special_study_or_event_reference resolve conditional triggers when ACCEPT-grounded tuples exist (currently zero ACCEPT tuples in 06_world).

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Classifies FY2025 cases without ordinary numeric DMR results into the five-way Purpose C taxonomy. Does not infer compliance or violation from absence alone. Prefers required_monitoring_lacks_adequate_evidence or unresolved over compliance/violation inference.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Universe is FY2025 DMR rows with value_kind in (nodi, qualifier_only) plus expected_monitoring_without_dmr_row tuples (394 cases). Cross-reference with Purpose B verdicts when available.
derivations.deterministic_computation: For nodi/qualifier DMR rows: when nodi_code or qualifier is mechanically present, classify other_documented_no_data_state unless permit_no_discharge_statement or conditional_monitoring_relief_evidence is ACCEPT-grounded. For absent DMR rows: when Purpose B establishes required, classify required_monitoring_lacks_adequate_evidence; when Purpose B establishes not_required, classify conditional_monitoring_not_required; otherwise unresolved.
derivations.required_premise: Identification of non-numeric DMR result or absent DMR row for a monitoring expectation in FY2025 scope.
derivations.optional_enrichment: ACCEPT-grounded documented_nodata_reason, permit_no_discharge_statement, and conditional_monitoring_relief_evidence tuples refine classification (none currently ACCEPT-grounded in 06_world).

limitations: 06_world/world.sqlite contains zero ACCEPT-grounded tuples for semantic world relations (discharge_occurrence_evidence, permit_no_discharge_statement, conditional_monitoring_relief_evidence, documented_nodata_reason). Purpose B conditional triggers and Purpose C no-discharge/relief branches therefore remain largely unresolved.
Purpose relations are not materialized in world.sqlite per 06_admission.json; derive_purposes.py writes purpose_ir JSON only.

Statistical-base alignment policy is not applied; pairs with matching units but differing statistical_base_code may be classified enforceable_numeric without separate unresolved handling unless unit comparison fails.
